title: Conversation 2026-11-21: auto indexes, learned from a private repository

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Topics: discovery, indexes. The owner and Claude Code built a private repository used by a non-technical user through a connector, with about 600 records. To let an agent find things by topic, by kind of event, by symptom-like categories and by time, the agent built index notes, derived tags (topic, category and month) and confidence scores, all generated by a script run on a 10-minute timer. The owner asked for a feature request for auto indexes from that experience.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: Opened by Claude Code, 2026-11-21. The repository itself is private and is not named here.
